title: 第七章 深山出域初临仙镇第八章 势利仙铺筑基资全
content_zh:
沧澜南疆，群山万壑。
冬日的深山林海，沉寂万古，风雪常驻。
烬孤宸一身破旧麻衣，独行于苍茫密林深处。
炼气大圆满的浑厚灵气，沉寂蛰伏于深邃气海之内，敛于血肉，藏于筋骨，不泄半分威压。若是不动，寻常凡夫肉眼、低阶妖兽灵识，根本无法察觉他是修行修士。
一路走来，荒林逐次退后，山野煞气尽数规避。
自踏入深山以来，他一路向南横穿边陲荒岭，吞草木灵机，纳妖兽精元，打磨出无瑕至极的炼气圆满道基。
此刻的他，肉身淬炼纯净无垢，灵气凝练厚重如海。
同阶修士大多根基虚浮、灵息驳杂、急于突破、滥筑道台。
唯独他，万灵归一，杂质尽去，一步一步苦修打磨，将炼气境打磨到这片低阶天地所能承载的极致圆满。
再往前，蛮荒深山的稀薄灵气，已然无法滋养他的道途。
筑基之路，需福地、需灵脉、需正统天地灵气。
唯有走出荒岭，入修士聚居之地，方能再踏前路。
步履从容，穿林踏雪。
越是靠近深山尽头，周遭天地风貌愈发不同。
原本枯败死寂的林海，渐渐生出点点青绿。
寒风不再刺骨凛冽，空气温润，灵气愈发绵密，丝丝缕缕萦绕周身，较之黑石镇浓郁十倍不止。
这是真正受灵泽滋养的大地。
不知行过多少山岭，前方厚重重叠的山林屏障，终于豁然开朗。
一线天光破开层峦叠嶂，映入眼帘。
远山退散，平川铺开。

一座依山而建、坐落沧澜南疆要道的青石古镇，静静匍匐在苍茫大地之上。
屋舍连绵，青石铺路，高墙规整，隐约可见街道纵横、行人往来。
炊烟袅袅，人声不息，车马穿行。
与黑石镇的破败贫瘠截然不同，此地建筑整齐、市面繁华、气韵沉稳。
空气中萦绕着若有若无的淡淡灵息，清润绵长，绝非凡俗凡尘可比。
青岚镇。
沧澜域南疆最边缘的修士集镇，是蛮荒深山与正统修行世界的交界之地。
凡人与修士共存，武者与修者混居。
凡人在此谋生，修士在此交易、落脚、休整、寻宝、入山。
这里，是真正修仙大道的入门之地。
烬孤宸驻足山林边缘，静静眺望远方古镇。
眸光淡漠无波，不起波澜。
十五年困于微尘，一朝踏出蛮荒，终见真正天地。
无欣喜，无好奇，无躁动。
他的心性早已冰封如渊，万事入眼，皆为过场。
content_en:
The southern border of Canglan is full of mountains and valleys.
In winter, the deep mountains and forests are silent for eternity, and the wind and snow are always there.
Jin Guchen was dressed in shabby linen clothes and walked alone in the depths of the vast dense forest.
The rich spiritual energy of the Great Perfection of Qi Refining lies silently and dormant in the deep sea of ​​qi, gathered in flesh and blood, hidden in the muscles and bones, and does not release even half of its pressure. If he didn't move, ordinary mortals' naked eyes and low-level monsters' spiritual consciousness wouldn't be able to detect that he was a cultivating monk.
Along the way, the wild forest retreated one by one, and the evil spirits of the mountains were avoided.
Since entering the deep mountains, he has traveled all the way south across the barren ridges of the border, swallowing the inspiration of plants and trees, absorbing the essence of monsters and beasts, and polishing the flawless foundation of Qi Refining Perfection.
At this moment, his body is tempered and pure, and his spiritual energy is as condensed and thick as the sea.
Most monks of the same level have weak foundations, mixed spiritual auras, are eager to make breakthroughs, and build Taoist platforms indiscriminately.
Only he can unite all spirits, remove all impurities, practice hard and polish step by step, and polish the Qi Refining Realm to the ultimate perfection that this low-level world can bear.
Going forward, the thin spiritual energy of the wild and remote mountains could no longer nourish his path.
The road to foundation building requires a blessed land, spiritual veins, and orthodox heaven and earth spiritual energy.
Only by walking out of the desolate ridge and entering a place where monks gather can we start our journey again.
Walking calmly through the forest and snow.
The closer you get to the end of the mountain, the more different the surrounding world becomes.
The forest sea, which was originally withered and dead, gradually grew green.
The cold wind is no longer biting and biting, the air is warm and moist, and the spiritual energy is becoming denser and lingering around the whole body. It is more than ten times richer than in Blackstone Town.
This is the earth that is truly nourished by spiritual energy.
After passing through countless mountains, the thick and overlapping mountain forest barrier in front of us finally became clear.
A ray of skylight broke through the mountains and came into view.
The distant mountains recede and the plains spread out.
A bluestone ancient town built on the mountain and located on the main road of Canglan's southern border, quietly creeping on the vast land.
The houses are continuous, the roads are paved with bluestones, and the high walls are regular. You can vaguely see the streets and pedestrians coming and going.
There is smoke from cooking pots, people are shouting, and cars and horses are passing by.
It is completely different from the dilapidated and barren Blackstone Town. The buildings here are neat, the market is prosperous, and the atmosphere is calm.
There is a faint spiritual breath lingering in the air, which is clear and moist, and is incomparable to the ordinary world.
Qinglan Town.
The monk town on the edge of the southern border of the Canglan Region is the interface between the wild mountains and the world of orthodox cultivation.
Mortals and monks coexisted, and warriors and cultivators lived together.
Mortals make a living here, and monks trade, stay, rest, hunt for treasures, and enter the mountains.
This is the entrance to the true path of cultivating immortality.
Jin Guchen stopped at the edge of the mountain forest and quietly looked at the ancient town in the distance.
The eyes are indifferent and unruffled.
After fifteen years of being trapped in the dust, once I stepped out of the wilderness, I finally saw the real world.
No joy, no curiosity, no restlessness.
His mind has long been frozen like an abyss, and everything he sees is just a formality.
